description: This source file implements two functions, HttpApoCbcReplyHeaders and HttpApoCbcReplyBody, which control the behavior of an HTTP proxy component, specifically for advanced proxy objects within the BroadWay Service Delivery System. The functions currently do not perform any logic beyond returning a process mode value.

methods.name: ULONG HttpApoCbcReplyHeaders(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSession,ANSC_HANDLE hMessage)
methods.description: Controls the proxy's behavior when reply headers are processed, currently returns a relay process mode.

methods.name: ULONG HttpApoCbcReplyBody(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSession,ANSC_HANDLE hMessage)
methods.description: Controls the proxy's behavior when reply body is processed, currently returns a relay process mode.
